The 'yoe9' metric is a derived kernel that combines historical performance with tracking data, while 'epa_att' provides a scalar measure of offensive value per attempt. The 'pass_rush_win_rate' is an isomorphic representation of defensive pressure effectiveness. These operators form a dualistic system: one side maps observed behaviors into probabilistic states (GSI), the other encodes dynamic transitions between these states (GSE).
